definitions.gloss: processed goods; manufactured product; processed item
definitions.explanation: A product that has been modified or transformed from its raw or natural state through manufacturing, refining, or other processing methods. Commonly refers to processed foods, but also applies to industrial products.

examples.japanese: {加工品|かこうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the raw materials of a processed product.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in food-related contexts. ⟦{加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}→加工食品：06605_kakoushokuhin⟧ (processed food) is a near-synonym but focuses specifically on food, while {加工品|かこうひん} can refer to any processed item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{加工品|かこうひん} (processed food products)
- {農産|のうさん}{加工品|かこうひん} (processed agricultural products)
- ⟦{水産|すいさん}→水産：04290_suisan⟧{加工品|かこうひん} (processed marine products)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}→加工食品：06605_kakoushokuhin⟧: processed food — specifically food that has been processed
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: product, manufactured goods — broader term for any commercially made item
